title: Loombridge Design Target — schema catalog
description: Schemas for the project-owned artifacts under .loombridge/design/ (plan §3c). PRODUCT-OWNED: the product (mcp-server) is the source of truth; individual projects do not author or version this schema. Two artifacts are described: `designTargetMeta` (the frozen hero shot's provenance written by `loombridge design`) and `annotationPatch` (the deterministic annotation→ACCEPTANCE patch produced by `plan`'s extractor in M2+).

designTargetMeta.title: design-target.json — frozen hero shot provenance
designTargetMeta.description: Lives at .loombridge/design/design-target.json. Records status, mode, frozen sha256, approval. Read by `loombridge design status`, `loombridge plan`, `loombridge verify`, `loombridge doneness`.

kind.description: The 3D design-target split. `rendered-unity-frame` (default when absent — pre-split files) is the FROZEN hero shot, eligible for strict hero-shot fidelity + doneness. `composition-reference` is a style/composition guide approved only to unlock 3D scene assembly; it can never certify doneness or final fidelity (capture a real Unity frame and re-set as `rendered-unity-frame` first).

heroShotHtml.description: Optional editable source filename, relative to .loombridge/design/.

pngSha256.description: sha256 of the hero-shot bytes at the last set/approve (the freeze).

approvedAt.description: ISO timestamp of approval; null while draft.

annotationPatch.title: annotation-patch.json — deterministic annotation→ACCEPTANCE patch
annotationPatch.description: Lives at .loombridge/design/annotation-patch.json. Auditable, diffable, replayable. Records `producedFromHash` (the hero shot's sha256 at extraction) so verify/regression can prove the contract derives from the approved target.

producedFromHash.description: sha256 of the hero-shot PNG at extraction time (idempotence + provenance, plan §3c).

op.description: RFC-6902-style op (no `remove`/`move`/`copy` in v1 — extractions are purely additive/overwriting).

value.description: The new value to add or replace. Typed per ACCEPTANCE field; deliberately unconstrained here.

conflict.description: True when the target path already differs in ACCEPTANCE — surfaces to the human-approval diff. Low-confidence ops that touch an existing field default to conflict=true.

annotationId.description: Optional reference back to the source annotation.
